'''2015 Match Play Championship''' was the Players Committee match-play championship, 1–3 May 2015. [[Joe Olson]] finished 1st. Day 2 is the published Final Four (names only); Day 1 is the constructed field.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-match-play-championship/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' United States
* '''Dates:''' 1–3 May 2015
* '''Winner:''' [[Joe Olson]]
